name: Necromancer audit: Summoning Expert raises Life Force to 3 and reaches raised minions (#3678)
contract: Summoning Expert 807494 (CharacterAdvancement 4237, ClassType 25 = class 23, RequiredLevel 30) reads 'Increases your maximum Life Force by $s1 and your Undead minion's Stamina by $s2%.' Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) MiscValue 31 (SPELLMOD_MAX_AURA_STACKS), EffectBasePoints 0 + DieSides 1 = +1, EffectSpellClassMask word 1 = 0x20000 in SpellFamilyName 29 -- the identical class mask, op and mechanism issue #1925 already proved native for Master Animator: it selects only Life Force 805011 (StackAmount 2) and 525004, and SpellInfo::CalcMaxAuraStacks (SpellInfo.cpp:1454) calls `modOwner->ApplySpellMod(Id, SPELLMOD_MAX_AURA_STACKS, maximum)`. Effect 1 is SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_APPLY_AURA_TO_SUMMONS (190) with aura 137 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_TOTAL_STAT_PERCENTAGE), MiscValue 2 (Stamina), EffectBasePoints 9 + DieSides 1 = +10 -- the same custom effect #1814's Rotting Flesh scenario and the Crown's Call scenario (necromancer-crowns-call-intellect-minions.json) already proved reaches the owner's already-summoned minions via the periodic UnitAura rescan, not only fresh summons. As the Crown's Call scenario's contract documents, the harness reads a non-pet minion's owned aura only through owned_creature_count's spell filter (Player::GetGuardianPet only returns a Category-2/IsPet minion; Lesser Skeletal Warrior 500970/50065 uses SummonProperties row 61, Category 1 SUMMON_CATEGORY_ALLY, so it is never the guardian pet and pet_aura_amount always reads 0/absent for it regardless of whether the aura is installed) -- so this scenario proves presence of Summoning Expert's aura on the raised minion, not its exact +10% Stamina magnitude, which was read directly from the DBC effect above. Both mechanisms are established, working, native/custom-native paths; nothing here needs a CoA script.

steps.label: Let the Life Force aura synchronize
PRECONDITION: Life Force capacity is 2 without the passive
Raise a Lesser Skeletal Warrior before the passive
CONTROL: the warrior carries no Summoning Expert aura yet
DISCRIMINATING: Summoning Expert raises Life Force capacity to 3
DISCRIMINATING: the already-raised warrior gets the Stamina aura via the periodic rescan
Raise a second warrior into the talented Life Force
DISCRIMINATING: a second warrior fits into the raised capacity 3
The Stamina aura reaches both raised warriors
